question: Which of the following countries is related with high yielding variety seeds that are used as part of Green Revolution policies in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mexico__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds were a major component of the Green Revolution.
 
• These seeds, developed in Mexico, are credited with significantly increasing food production.
 
• The introduction of HYV seeds in India marked the beginning of the Green Revolution in the 1960s.
 
• These seeds require proper irrigation and chemical fertilizers to produce higher yields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
Term

 
 
 
Description

 
 
 

 
 
Green Revolution

 
 
 
A period of agricultural transformation in the 1960s and 1970s that increased food production worldwide, especially in developing countries, through the adoption of new technologies, including high-yielding variety seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation methods.

 
 
 

 
 
Norman Borlaug

 
 
 
Known as the "Father of the Green Revolution," he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1970 for his work in developing high-yielding crops and thereby improving food security globally.

 
 
 

 
 
Impact in India

 
 
 
The Green Revolution turned India from a food-importing country to a self-sufficient one. However, it also had environmental and social impacts, including increased use of water and agrochemicals.

 
 
 

 
 
Future Challenges

 
 
 
Addressing the sustainability of agriculture by reducing dependency on chemical inputs and increasing the use of organic and environmentally friendly farming practices.
